Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, this blessed month
In which the Quran was revealed
And was made as guidance for mankind
And clear proofs of guidance and distinction
Has arrived
So make us safe in it
And preserve it for us

Arabic text: وَتَسَلَّمْهُ مِنَّا فِيْ يُسْرٍ مِنْكَ وَعَافِيَةٍ
Translation: And accept it from us with ease from You and well-being

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ أَخَذَ الْقَلِيلَ وَشَكَرَ الْكَثِيرَ
Translation: O You who accepts little and gives thanks abundantly
Accept from me what is little
O Allah, I ask You

Arabic text: أَنْ تَجْعَلَ لِيْ إِلٰى كُلِّ خَيْرٍ سَبِيلًا
Translation: To make for me a way to every goodness
And to prevent me from everything You dislike
O Most Merciful of those who show mercy

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ عَفَا عَنِّيْ وَعَمَّا خَلَوْتُ بِهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ
Translation: O You who pardoned me and what I committed in private of sins

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يُؤاخِذْنِيْ بِارْتِكَابِ الْمَعَاصِيْ
Translation: O You who did not hold me accountable for committing disobedience
Your pardon, Your pardon, Your pardon, O Generous One
My God, You admonished me but I did not take heed
And You warned me against Your prohibitions but I did not desist
So what is my excuse?
So pardon me, O Generous One
Your pardon, Your pardon
O Allah, I ask You
For comfort at the time of death
And forgiveness at the time of reckoning
Great is the sin from Your servant
So let Your overlooking be greater

Arabic text: يَا أَهْلَ التَّقْوٰى وَيَا أَهْلَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
Translation: O Guardian of piety and O Guardian of forgiveness
Your pardon, Your pardon

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ بْنُ عَبْدِكَ بْنُ أَمَتِكَ
Translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant
Weak, in need of Your mercy

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ مُنْزِلُ الْغِنىٰ وَالْبَرَكَةِ عَلَى الْعِبَادِ
Translation: And You are the One who sends down wealth and blessings upon Your servants
Dominant, Powerful
You have enumerated their deeds
And distributed their provisions
And made their languages and colors different
Creation after creation
And the servants do not know Your knowledge
And the servants cannot estimate Your worth
And all of us are in need of Your mercy
So do not turn Your face away from me
And make me among the righteous of Your creation
In deeds and aspirations
And in destiny and fate
O Allah, keep me alive in the best way

Arabic text: وَأَفْنِنِيْ خَيْرَ الْفَنَاءِ عَلَى مُوَالَاةِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
Translation: And cause me to die in the best way, upon loyalty to Your friends
And enmity to Your enemies
And desire for You and fear of You
And humility and faithfulness and submission to You
And belief in Your Book
And following the tradition of Your Messenger
O Allah, whatever is in my heart
Of doubt or suspicion
Or denial or despair

Arabic text: أَوْ فَرَحٍ أَوْ بَذَخٍ أَوْ بَطَرٍ
Translation: Or excessiveness or arrogance or insolence

Arabic text: أَوْ خُيَلاءَ أَوْ رِيَاءٍ أَوْ سُمْعَةٍ
Translation: Or vanity or showing off or seeking fame
Or discord or hypocrisy

Arabic text: أَوْ كُفْرٍ أَوْ فُسُوقٍ أَوْ عِصْيَانٍ
Translation: Or disbelief or immorality or disobedience
Or haughtiness or anything You dislike

Arabic text: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبِّ أَنْ تُبَدِّلَنِيْ مَكَانَهُ إِيمَانًا بِوَعْدِكَ
Translation: I ask You, O Lord, to replace it with faith in Your promise
And fulfillment of Your covenant
And satisfaction with Your decree
And detachment from this world
And desire for what is with You
And preference and tranquility
And sincere repentance
I ask You this, O Lord of the worlds

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ أَنْتَ مِنْ حِلْمِكَ تُعْصىٰ فَكَأَنَّكَ لَمْ تَرَ
Translation: My God, You are disobeyed due to Your forbearance as if You do not see

Arabic text: وَمِنْ كَرَمِكَ وَجُودِكَ تُطَاعُ فَكَأَنَّكَ لَمْ تُعْصَ
Translation: And You are obeyed due to Your generosity and bounty as if You were not disobeyed

Arabic text: وَأَنَا وَمَنْ لَمْ يَعْصِكَ سُكَّانُ أَرْضِكَ
Translation: And I and those who do not disobey You are dwellers of Your earth
So be generous to us with Your grace
And repeatedly grant us goodness
O Most Merciful of those who show mercy

Arabic text: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ صَلاةً دَائِمَةً
Translation: And may Allah's blessings be upon Muhammad and his family, continuous blessings
That cannot be counted or enumerated
And none can estimate its worth except You
O Most Merciful of those who show mercy
